newsitem.title: USA: AT&T shrs open NYSE trade with 8 pct decline.
newsitem.headline: AT&T shrs open NYSE trade with 8 pct decline.

text.p: Shares in AT&T Corp commenced New York Stock Exchange trade half an hour late with a swift eight percent decline, or 4-5/8 points, to 52-5/8.

AT&T's open was delayed by an order imbalance, and the sharp decline came after the company said early Tuesday that results for the third and fourth quarters will be below security analysts' expectations because of competition in the long-distance telephone market, among other reasons.
The sharp decline launched AT&T to the top of the NYSE net losers list.
